Around the contact moment (between 226 and 237, with the event anchored at 231), the sphere closes directly into the leading block of the cluster; this is the first encountered obstacle in that row.
By frame 248, the blue sphere is already past the contacted block, with the row now behind/below it in the image, so the contact is not a rearward or after-passing interaction.
Although the approach is slightly diagonal in image space, the temporal sequence supports an obstacle-ahead impact more than a pure side swipe, so the geometry is best classified as depth/front.
